WMNST 100.name: Introduction to Women's and Gender Studies
WMNST 100.description: Introduction to women's and gender studies. Prerequisite for upper-level courses in the major.

WMNST 106N.name: Representing Women and Gender in Literature, Art and Popular Cultures
WMNST 106N.description: Representations of women and gender in literature, art, and popular culture. Prerequisite for upper-level courses in the major.

WMNST 83N.name: First-Year Seminar in Women's Studies
WMNST 83N.description: First-year seminar in women's studies. Bulletin's own Suggested Academic Plan cites 'WMNST 83S', which could not be confirmed to exist (only WMNST 83N is in the current catalog) -- used WMNST 83N.

WMNST 301N.name: Sexualities, Gender and Power: Feminist Thought and Politics
WMNST 301N.description: Feminist thought and politics on sexuality, gender, and power.

WMNST 400N.name: Debates in Contemporary Feminism
WMNST 400N.description: Debates in contemporary feminism. Bulletin's own prereq text contains department typos (e.g. 'WMST 106'); normalized to WMNST 100/106N and WMNST 301N.

WMNST 401.name: Doing Feminism: Theory and Practice
WMNST 401.description: Feminist theory and practice. Bulletin's own prereq text contains a department typo ('WMNST005'); normalized to WMNST 100/106N and WMNST 301N.

WMNST 494.name: Research Project
WMNST 494.description: Supervised research project activities. Bulletin credit range is 1-12, max 12; modeled at 3cr, matching the plan's own Semester 7 placement.

WMNST 495.name: Internship
WMNST 495.description: Supervised internship. Bulletin credit range is 1-18, max 18; modeled at 3cr. Bulletin requires prior approval of the proposed assignment, which the planner schema does not model directly.

WMNST 496.name: Independent Studies
WMNST 496.description: Independent studies. Bulletin credit range is 1-18, max 18; modeled at 3cr.

WMNST 492W.name: Contemporary Feminist Analysis: The Capstone Senior Seminar
WMNST 492W.description: Capstone senior seminar in contemporary feminist analysis. Writing Across the Curriculum. Bulletin's own prereq text contains a department typo ('WMNST001'); normalized to WMNST 100/106N, WMNST 301N, and WMNST 400N (accepting WMNST 401 as an equivalent, since the plan's own Semester 5 pool item lets a student complete either one).
